cases.description: Explain a weekly run that succeeded but did not update a formula, using the per-formula revert and hidden livecheck errors.
cases.prompt: The weekly update-formulas run is green and opened a PR, but one formula that has a new upstream release is not in it. How do I triage it? This is a workflow-derived desk exercise: do not edit anything, run installs, or perform network requests. No tap checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the tap files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Says the weekly job reverts a formula whose bump, resources, audit, build or test fails and continues, so the log's per-formula warning (not the job status) shows it, and the PR can open without that formula.
Says to run brew livecheck --json locally because the workflow hides livecheck errors and reads failure as up to date, and notes a deprecate! or disable! formula is skipped on purpose.
Delegates the repair to homebrew-fix-formula and finishes with homebrew-verify.

cases.description: Treat a rejected dispatch payload as data and fix it at the producer.
cases.prompt: A producer's repository_dispatch to this tap failed with an invalid formula token error. The payload was {"formula":"My Widget","version":"1.2.3"}. What is wrong and how do I fix it? This is a workflow-derived desk exercise: do not edit anything, run installs, or perform network requests. No tap checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the tap files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Identifies that the formula token must match the anchored pattern in the dispatch workflow's Validate payload step and 'My Widget' does not, so the producer must send the lowercase token.
Says not to relax validation to accept spaces or shell syntax and never to interpolate payload text into shell source.
Notes a valid token for a file that does not exist fails with not found, and that the version is optional.

cases.description: Explain why an automated update PR has no bottle build and how to get one.
cases.prompt: The automated update PR for a formula shows no tests.yml run and no bottles, so I cannot apply pr-pull. Is the workflow broken? This is a workflow-derived desk exercise: do not edit anything, run installs, or perform network requests. No tap checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the tap files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Says this is expected: a PR opened with GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger tests.yml, so the bump job audits, builds from source and tests inside its own run instead.
Says to close and reopen the PR or push to its branch to run tests.yml, then apply pr-pull after bottles are built.
Does not recommend widening token permissions as the fix.
